dimensions.assessment: Affects operators of private or majority-private ferry services operating between adjoining states, ferry terminal operators, and passengers using interstate ferry routes.
dimensions.evidence: a privately or majority-privately owned ferry or ferry terminal facility is an eligible entity for purposes of participation in the Ferry Boat Program

dimensions.assessment: Opens federal funding eligibility for construction and purchase to private interstate ferry operators and establishes specific caps and formulas on the fares they may charge.
dimensions.evidence: Federal participation may involve the construction or purchase, for private ownership, of--(I) a ferry boat that operates between 2 adjoining States; or (II) a ferry terminal facility

dimensions.assessment: Allows federal participation and funding from existing programs (Ferry Boat Program and Surface Transportation Block Grant Program) to flow to private entities, though no specific new appropriation amount is stated.
dimensions.evidence: ferry boats and terminal facilities that are eligible for funding under section 129(c)

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 23 of the United States Code to alter eligibility rules, construction funding provisions, and fare-setting oversight for interstate ferries.
dimensions.evidence: amend title 23, United States Code, so that a privately or majority-privately owned ferry or ferry terminal facility is an eligible entity

dimensions.assessment: Makes permanent statutory changes to federal transportation funding eligibility starting one year after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall take affect... on the date that is 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total amount of federal funds that will be redirected or requested by private ferry operators.
Number of private ferry routes nationwide that meet the interstate criteria.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends federal transportation law to make privately or majority-privately owned interstate ferries and ferry terminal facilities eligible entities for the Ferry Boat Program and Surface Transportation Block Grant Program, subject to fare regulation.
